partition_boundary.analog: The 2T gain-cell bitcell (design/gain_cell_2t.sch/.spice, layout/gain_cell_2t.gds) and the shared-tap 4x4 array built from it (layout/gain_cell_2t_array.gds); the sense path is future work tracked in #24. Evidence today: items 3 and 4 cover the committed bitcell artifacts, re-verified against the current deck by the reports cited below; item 11 (power delivery, structural) is cited for the analog partition only and covers the shared-tap 4x4 array (layout/gain_cell_2t_array.gds): its ERC and LVS reports are pinned to that layout's content hash.
partition_boundary.digital: Behavioral Verilog RTL under digital/ (refresh scheduler, SPI slave, phase sequencer and their integrations, plus the SPI clock-domain-crossing model) with Icarus Verilog regressions and mutation suites driven by digital/ci/run_digital_regressions.sh. Not synthesized, no gate-level replay, no place-and-route, not signed off: every digital-partition T1 row other than item 9 is unmet and cites no evidence. Item 9 (testbenches shipped) is cited for the digital partition only, as the artifact-anchored attestation envelope attest/item9.digital.envelope.json; it attests that the benches and cold-start command are committed with pinned tools, not that the design is correct beyond what those behavioral benches check.
